visualCharacteristics: Edge-to-edge logo-on-colour image tiles in a 4-column grid with small gaps
contentPattern: 8 logo-version tiles (image only, 4 per row, 2 rows)
usage: One row per logo version. Cell 1: the logo tile image. Cell 2 (optional): a version label shown under the tile. 4 per row on desktop, 2 on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Logo version/lockup grids on sub-brand guides and the logos chapter
